connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -9.76, length 3.24 mm) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm, y -9.76 -> -3.16) touching the radiating edge y=-3.16 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

parasitic_params.note: Floating sheet (no via, no probe), same metal as the patch, unchanged with respect to US3_PS6 (Wp 11.0, Lp 7.05 mm, y -2.91...4.14, centre 0.615 mm, z 1.035). The patch edge is y = -3.16 (patch_L/2); the transformer ends there on z = h and the sheet (z = 1.035) starts 0.25 mm above it in y. The edge -2.91 must not be moved (prepare grading check).

geometry_checks.board_margin_mm: as US3_PS6 / US3_PS1 (26 x 26 mm board)

rationale: Owner request 2026-11-16: PS6 with a slightly longer patch_L to lower the resonance by a few MHz. Reference US3_PS6 (rounds 038 base / 039 fine): single S11 minimum at 8.005 GHz, worst S11 -8.16 dB (base) / -8.14 dB (fine) at 7.7376 GHz, upper edge -10.40 dB (base). GUIDE_MODEL, not an EM result: observed PS5 -> PS6 slope about -5.5 MHz per +0.01 mm (confounded by mesh changes), patch guide -7 MHz per +0.01 mm; +0.03 mm -> about -15 ... -21 MHz, i.e. minimum near 7.984-7.990 GHz (uncertainty at least +-8 MHz). Expected trade-off: the lower edge improves (the minimum approaches f0 = 7.9872 GHz from above) while the upper edge loses margin. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11, efficiency or gain is claimed.
purpose: Lower the single-minimum resonance of US3_PS6 by about 15-21 MHz by lengthening the driven patch only (patch_L 6.29 -> 6.32 mm); openEMS base + fine mesh.

US3_PS6.note: single design change: driven patch length +0.03 mm. Parasitic (11.0 x 7.05 mm, y -2.91..4.14, z 1.035), U-slot (absolute), transformer 0.80 x 6.60, material, board and port unchanged. All derived metadata recomputed from the polygons; the stale PS5-inherited metadata of US3_PS6.json (see US3_PS6.errata.json) was NOT copied.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H0: Single S11 minimum in 7.980-7.995 GHz (guide: 8.005 - 15...21 MHz = 7.984-7.990 GHz); no second minimum in the channel.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Worst S11 in the channel (1 MHz grid, 501 samples) <= -10 dB (038/039: -8.16 / -8.14 dB at 7.7376 GHz). WARNING: the upper channel edge will lose margin (038 upper edge -10.40 dB base) as the minimum moves down; H1 may fail at the upper edge even if the lower edge improves. Not claimed.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: eta >= 0.55 and realized broadside gain >= 2 dBi at the 11 NF2FF points (PS5 037: eta 0.64-0.69, gain 3.0-4.25 dBi; no efficiency valley expected).
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 and H2 true -> candidate refinement of US3_PS6 (fine mesh and HFSS are owner decisions). Lower edge improves but the upper edge falls below -8 dB -> report the trade-off; the worst edge decides, do not continue patch_L without the owner. Minimum moves by more than 15 MHz away from the guide -> recalibrate the slope with 038/039 and this round before any further change.

manufacturability.layers: 3 copper layers (L1 patch + feed + U-slot at z=h, L2 floating parasitic at z=1.035 mm, L3 ground at z=0) and 2 dielectric layers of ~1.035 mm each: a standard 3-copper-layer FR4 multilayer (core + prepreg/core).
manufacturability.vias: none: the parasitic is floating (no probe, no plated through hole in the antenna region); the feed is a planar microstrip.
manufacturability.min_feature_mm: U-slot arms 0.8 mm and gaps unchanged; parasitic is a solid rectangle 11.0 x 7.05 mm; smallest planar gap: 0.25 mm in y between the transformer end and the sheet edge (different layers, z offset 1.035 mm); no copper feature < 0.8 mm.
manufacturability.stackup_note: Dielectric thickness and the exact z of the buried copper depend on the fabricator's core/prepreg library; typical core thicknesses of ~1.0-1.2 mm and prepreg of 0.1-0.2 mm are only an orientation (NOT verified against a datasheet). The model assumes ONE homogeneous eps_r=4.4 over 2.07 mm, so the fabricator must give the real stackup (the prepreg/core eps_r can differ from the core and sets z_par and k).
manufacturability.tolerances_to_specify: layer-to-layer registration and dielectric thickness (+-z_par moves k and f2); etching of patch_L (guide ~7-10 MHz per 0.01 mm; the intended +0.03 mm change corresponds to ~20 MHz). Same rough FR4 + copper-roughness caveat as the rest of the campaign.
manufacturability.risks: z_par and registration are not controlled by the TFG; homogeneous provisional FR4 model; a floating inner sheet cannot be inspected or tuned after lamination. The change (+0.03 mm) is small versus etching tolerance (guide ~7-10 MHz per 0.01 mm: an error of +-0.02 mm is about +-15-20 MHz, as large as the intended shift), and the 0.25 mm y offset of the sheet edge from the patch edge is of the order of the layer registration tolerance.
